Senses.Explanation: The estate steward is the monastery officer responsible for an outlying estate or farm and its material business. A monastic code lists the office among the garden superintendent and other administrators; a biography identifies Longya Zhicai by his former service as the Taiping estate steward. In the Nanquan case, the steward prepares to receive Nanquan Puyuan at the estate and answers for that preparation. The office can therefore identify both an institutional post and its holder, but these are the same role rather than separate senses.
